thread.title: Facebook Shareholder Proposal Targets Zuckerberg | Investor's Business Daily

author: BRIAN DEAGON
title: Facebook Shareholder Proposal Targets Zuckerberg | Investor's Business Daily
text:
Four public investment funds with large holdings in Facebook ( FB ) stock on Wednesday joined a shareholder proposal to oust Mark Zuckerberg as chairman of the company he co-founded.
X
The state treasurers of Illinois, Rhode Island, Pennsylvania, and the comptroller of New York City joined the shareholder proposal previously filed by Trillium Asset Management in June.
The group of institutional investors requested the Facebook board of directors make the role of chairman an independent position.
"Doing so is best governance practice that will be in the interest of shareholders, employees, users, and our democracy," the announcement said.

Please contact customer service CLOSE The effort to install an independent chairman at Facebook aims to improve governance and accountability. It follows a series on controversies and security breaches that put a focus on Facebook's corporate oversight.
Mark Zuckerberg's Voting Power The proposal is largely symbolic, with no practical effect on Zuckerberg's position as both chairman and chief executive. Zuckerberg's share of voting power totals 59.9%.
Still, the proposal goes to a vote at Facebook's annual shareholder meeting in May. And it increases the scrutiny over Facebook's corporate governance after a string of missteps and controversies.
"Facebook plays an outsized role in our society and our economy," said New York City Comptroller Scott Stringer in a written statement. "They have a social and financial responsibility to be transparent. That's why we're demanding independence and accountability in the company's boardroom."
The shareholder proposal focuses on Facebook's mishandling of a number of controversies, such as Russia's meddling in the U.S. elections. They also cited the Cambridge Analytica breach that accessed data on 87 million Facebook users. The latest controversy involved a data breach, disclosed last month, in which hackers stole the personal information on 29 million people.
Dark Side Of Social Media The dark side of social media came to light after the 2016 presidential contest. Probes revealed that the social media platforms of Facebook, Twitter ( TWTR ) and the YouTube unit of Alphabet ( GOOGL ) were used to conduct misinformation campaigns by Russian state actors .
The Facebook shareholder proposal highlights that Alphabet, Microsoft ( MSFT ), Apple ( AAPL ), Oracle ( ORCL ) and Twitter have separate chief executive and chairman roles.
